title: Cannot check "plasmashell --version" with DISPLAY unset
line: plasmashell --version now prints the version over ssh or anywhere without a display, instead of aborting.
explanation: plasmashell creates its QApplication, which needs a working Wayland or X11 connection, before QCommandLineParser handles --version. Without a display (for example over ssh) Qt aborts while loading the platform plugin, so the version is never printed. Even with a display, --version first built a ShellCorona, which touches D-Bus. The change checks argv for -v/--version at the very start of main() and prints "plasmashell <version>" before anything else is set up.

commits.message:
shell: print the version without needing a display

plasmashell --version aborted when no display was available, such as in
an ssh session, because QApplication is created before the command line
is parsed. Now -v and --version are handled before QApplication exists.

BUG: 401231

patches.diff:
From 0916ae97ff361f88a05f01d4556d756805978689 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 04:06:24 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] shell: print the version without needing a display

plasmashell --version aborted when no display was available, such as in
an ssh session, because QApplication is created before the command line
is parsed. Now -v and --version are handled before QApplication exists.

BUG: 401231
---
 shell/main.cpp | 9 +++++++++
 1 file changed, 9 insertions(+)

diff --git a/shell/main.cpp b/shell/main.cpp
index ce385db4e4..8cc629770c 100644
--- a/shell/main.cpp
+++ b/shell/main.cpp
@@ -35,6 +35,7 @@
 #include <KSignalHandler>
 
 #include <csignal>
+#include <cstdio>
 
 #if __has_include(<malloc.h>)
 #include <malloc.h>
@@ -60,6 +61,14 @@ static void setupMalloc()
 
 int main(int argc, char *argv[])
 {
+    // Handled before QApplication, which needs a display, so this also works over ssh
+    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
+        if (qstrcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0 || qstrcmp(argv[i], "--version") == 0) {
+            std::printf("plasmashell %s\n", PROJECT_VERSION);
+            return 0;
+        }
+    }
+
 #if __has_include(<malloc.h>) && defined(__GLIBC__)
     setupMalloc();
 #endif
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: plasmashell --version and -v without a display abort with exit 134
With the fix: both print plasmashell 6.8.80 and exit 0

review.text: Simple, self-contained fix in shell/main.cpp that handles -v and --version before QApplication is constructed (which requires a display server in Qt 6) and prints "plasmashell <PROJECT_VERSION>" matching KAboutData's output format. Directly addresses the reported SSH/headless use case with no startup overhead and clear before/after verification.

reviews.text: Simple, self-contained fix in shell/main.cpp that handles -v and --version before QApplication is constructed (which requires a display server in Qt 6) and prints "plasmashell <PROJECT_VERSION>" matching KAboutData's output format. Directly addresses the reported SSH/headless use case with no startup overhead and clear before/after verification.

Correct diagnosis: QApplication is built before QCommandLineParser sees --version, so no display means abort. Scanning argv for -v/--version at the top of main() and printing PROJECT_VERSION in KAboutData's format is minimal, side-effect free and closes the bug as titled (the reporter only asked for --version). Before/after shots match the patch and the commit message is accurate. The hand-rolled check ignores combined short flags like -nv, which is harmless since those fall back to the old path.
